economy.summary: His campaign lists lowering costs, fighting for living wages, and helping families put food on the table among his priorities, and features a petition to raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage.
economy.short: Supports lowering costs, living wages, raising the minimum wage.

abortion.summary: Cosponsored House Bill 1957 in the 2025-2026 session, a proposed amendment to the Pennsylvania Constitution providing for personal reproductive liberty.
abortion.short: Cosponsored proposed constitutional amendment for personal reproductive liberty.

education.summary: His campaign lists fairly funding public schools among the issues he says he is fighting for.
education.short: Lists fairly funding public schools as a priority.

healthcare.summary: A nurse by profession, he co-chairs the Medicare for All Caucus, and his campaign highlights expanding healthcare access and legislation he passed on safe staffing for nurses and medical debt cancellation.
healthcare.short: Co-chairs Medicare for All Caucus; cites safe-staffing, medical-debt laws.

energy.summary: In June 2026 he urged state House members to support a bill capping corporate utility profits, saying it would reduce energy bills and force investment into infrastructure upgrades.
energy.short: Urged capping utility profits to reduce energy bills.

guns.summary: Was one of the sponsors of House Bill 1852 in the 2023-2024 session, which would have required licensed firearms dealers to conduct background checks and record buyer information on consignment sales, maintain video surveillance, and report lost or stolen firearms within 24 hours.
guns.short: Sponsored dealer bill: background checks, surveillance, lost-gun reporting.
